title: B6 Lantern Study Main Menu
summary: Approved B6 folding-screen menu with the original five-ring artwork, cropped bonsai, Japanese border and slow room illumination at 85%. Native controls and review only; no merge.
review_steps: Extract the whole ZIP and open Start Review.cmd. The game opens directly to the new main menu with fresh preview settings.
Watch the lantern illumination on the screen, sigils and floor. It should drift slowly and warmly at the approved default of 85%.
Try each menu entry with the mouse and with Up/Down, Tab and Enter. Play opens Practice and Duel Demo. Library and Deck Builder should return with Escape and restore keyboard focus.
Open Options. Confirm 85% by default; change the slider, restart and verify it is remembered. Reduced motion should make the room lighting steady.
Try F11 and a resized window. The full folding screen should remain visible, with letterboxing where needed. Quit should require confirmation.
Leave any UI or QoL feedback on PR #471. Alfredo approved the visual concept; native implementation acceptance and merge remain pending review.
known_limitations: Review branch only, based on main 1e494ebe; other unmerged UI previews are separate.
No rules, network or pinned-deck changes. Private Match UI can be inspected; remote connection testing requires the existing separate server.
Native Mac rendering/input were checked; Windows package/runtime validation is distinct from human Windows graphical acceptance.
Static source/native pixels match at original size with steady light. Animation, selected entries and functional submenus intentionally differ from the still concept.
